notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature tapped in step 5.
